messages:
morgan: Heads-up — saw a cluster of logins where JIT provisioning ran but users ended up with only the default `viewer` role even though the SAML assertion included `roles`.
morgan: This started after the proxy attr-sanitizer config landed yesterday (PATCH: identity/proxy 9f3b2d).
izaac: :eyes: can you paste an example assertion? suspect attribute name normalization issue.
sg-identity-bot: alert: 2026-03-19T15:01:10Z - 22 auth events failed role-mapping check (reason=attribute_missing)
rachel: example SAML payload (sanitized):
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="email">alice@example.com</Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="eppn">alice</Attribute>
  <!-- roles missing here, should be: <Attribute Name="roles">platform-admin,infra</Attribute> -->
</AttributeStatement>
```
morgan: exact — the `roles` attribute is being dropped by the proxy because the attr-sanitizer regex/allowlist strips unknown attributes with a dash/underscore.
devon: I pulled the proxy change. It added `allowedAttributes: [email,eppn,displayName,groups]` and an `attribute_normalize` step that strips non-alphanum chars. so `roles` -> `roles` should be okay but the issuer we're getting sends `X-Roles`.
izaac: ah `X-Roles` vs `roles` — Okta mapping was sending `roles` as `X-Roles` header name when transforming. the sanitizer strips header-style attrs.
sre-oncall: impact summary: ~18 interactive users + 4 service accounts got default viewer perms. No failed logins, just underprivileged access.
rachel: short-term mitigation: relax the sanitizer to accept `X-Roles` or add a mapping rule to normalize header-style names back to `roles`.
devon: long-term: we should make role-mapping resilient to attribute name variants. I propose:
- add audit events on role assignment failures with reason codes
- support fallback to group membership if `roles` missing
- normalize common prefixes (X-, x-, app_) in proxy
morgan: +1 on audit events. currently role mapping returns 200 with `assigned=viewer` and no explicit log for why `roles` was absent.
izaac: quick patch: updating identity/proxy config to include `X-Roles` in allowlist and adding a normalizer for `X-Roles` -> `roles`. I'll open PR now.
sg-identity-bot: PR created: identity/proxy#482 — add X-Roles allowlist and normalizer (link)
morgan: can we also backfill users who lost elevated perms? recommend running a backfill job that re-evaluates SAML assertions for affected users using the logs between 2026-03-19T14:30 and 2026-03-19T15:10.
devon: agree. wrote a draft script to re-evaluate mappings against stored assertions: `scripts/backfill_role_mapping.sh` — needs KMS access to decrypt assertion blobs.
rachel: note: KMS rotation last month means the backfill job needs the new key alias `projects/redwood/keys/identity-saml-decrypt`. I'll add the IAM allowlist and run in staging first.
sre-oncall: I've opened SEC-421 and assigned to devon/izaac. Will also add a postmortem template link.
morgan: thanks — schedule 30-min sync in 15 to validate PR + backfill plan. :thumbsup:
izaac: on it, will post status when PR merges.
